PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This privacy policy explains which personal data MS Infra processes when you use our website or contact us.

data.title: 2. What data do we process?
data.description: When you use the contact form, we may process the following personal data:

purposes.title: 3. Why do we process your data?
purposes.description: We use your data to respond to your request, contact you and follow up on commercial or project-related communication where appropriate.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Processing takes place where necessary to handle your request, take steps at your request before entering into an agreement, or on the basis of MS Infra's legitimate interest in handling enquiries and business communication appropriately.

processors.title: 5. External service providers
processors.description: We may use external service providers for the operation of our website and communications. These providers process personal data only insofar as necessary to provide their services.
processors.brevo: We use Brevo as our email service provider to send messages submitted through the contact form.

retention.title: 6. Retention period
retention.description: Personal data is not retained longer than necessary for the purpose for which it was collected and insofar as required to comply with legal or administrative obligations.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.description: You may request access to, correction or deletion of your personal data. Where applicable, you may also object to processing or request that processing be restricted.

security.title: 8. Security
security.description: MS Infra takes appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorised access or misuse.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies
cookies.description: This website currently does not use non-essential marketing or tracking cookies. If this changes in the future, we will update this privacy policy and the website's cookie settings accordingly.

changes.title: 10. Changes
changes.description: MS Infra may update this privacy policy when the website, our services or applicable regulations change.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.description: If you have questions about how we process your personal data or wish to exercise one of your privacy rights, please contact us at:
